evals.prompt: The web squad starts a site called Acme Site and has no project yet.
evals.expected_output: Creates ~/Projects/web/acme-site, calls desktop_project create (or hermes -p web project create outside Desktop), runs project_sync.py so every worker has it, verifies with hermes -p <bot> project list, and tells the user to pick web in the Sessions selector.

evals.prompt: The manager sees the project but web-frontend says 'No projects yet'.
evals.expected_output: Explains that Project state is per profile and runs project_sync.py, which creates the project only in the workers that lack it, then verifies with project list.

evals.prompt: Move the project into a new folder layout for me.
evals.expected_output: Uses hermes project add-folder / set-primary on each profile holding the project; does not hand-edit the project database.
